$comment: Motion output targets (docs/MOTION-OUTPUT.md 7). One entry per consumer; the host sends a copy to every enabled target (we are the sender, so 'one listener per port' does not bite). Ports: FlyPT Mover LFS source 4123/4124 ID 1 (Opts 1ff); SimTools LFS plugin classic 64 B on 4123 ID 0; SimHub LFS 63393/63392 (Opts 1ff); Forza Data Out to the port SimHub's Forza page shows (5300 assumed - read it in the UI); i76motion 7677. frame: world | body for the LFS formats (world = the LFS developer's statement; owner test T2 settles it). Packets go to UDP only with --send / --live, and only to loopback unless a target sets allow_remote. clamp / slew: off for software (the rig software crops).

targets.name: simtools
targets.note: shares 4123 with flypt in a different format: enable one of the two

targets.name: simhub-forza
targets.note: SimHub game 'Forza Motorsport 7'; check the port in SimHub's Forza settings
